intro.title: The Drowned Quarter
intro.drownedQuarter1: _The Drowned Quarter 1_: The sound of crackling electricity greets you as you enter the undersea dome. Flooded trenches and crumbling ruins cover the round plaza on the seafloor. Try as you might, your eyes keep drifting to the ocean beyond the alien barrier. A bloom of jellyfish floats dreamily through the tenebrous depths. If the energy field were to disappear for any reason, the expedition would surely be swept away.
intro.headedWest: If the expedition headed west, proceed to _The Drowned Quarter 2_.
intro.headedEast: If the expedition headed east, skip to _The Drowned Quarter 3_.
intro.drownedQuarter2: _The Drowned Quarter 2_: “I think this is the source,” Andy points to the round structure in the center of the plaza. Bolts of electricity lick the shimmering bubble above. The structure is the source of the glow and, presumably, the energy field protecting these ruins from the ocean water. Inside, you find a spinning orrery: a complex mechanism of hovering spheres and whirring gears that stir a constant electric current. Locked at its core is an incandescent orb. Andy fidgets nervously. “It’s powering the machine. I don’t know what’ll happen if we take it out but…it looks like something Mr. Tillinghast would want.”
intro.drownedQuarter2Conclusion: Before you can object, he sets to operating the ancient controls. There may be a way to remove the orb without drowning…
intro.drownedQuarter3: _The Drowned Quarter 3_: You follow the expedition past pits of deep water and sunken ruins to the source of the glow and, presumably, the energy field. Inside it, you find a spinning orrery: a complex mechanism of hovering spheres and whirring gears that stir a constant electric current. Locked at its core is an incandescent orb. Ruby gasps. “It’s some kind of pumping station. I’d wager that orb is an important part of it. It’s possible that stealing it could bring the ocean down on our heads.” She smiles rakishly. “So you’d better be ready to run.”
intro.drownedQuarter3Conclusion: Before you can object, she sets to operating the ancient controls. There may be a way to take the orb without drowning…
intro.resolveNoPlaceLikeHome: If an investigator has the No Place Like Home Task, they resolve their respective story on the following page.

easyStandard.skull: -X. X is half the number of revealed locations (rounded down).
easyStandard.cultist: -2. If you fail and your location is fully flooded, take 1 damage.
easyStandard.tablet: -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
easyStandard.elderThing: -3 (-5 instead if your location is not flooded).

hardExpert.skull: -X. X is the number of revealed locations.
hardExpert.cultist: -3. If your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
hardExpert.tablet: -4. For each point you fail by, place 1 of your clues on your location.
hardExpert.elderThing: -4 (-6 instead if your location is not flooded).

xp.bonus: for studying the Drowned Quarter at length

resolution1.title: Resolution 1
resolution1.body: _Resolution 1_: The strange node pulses in your hand, projecting a soft bubble of light that repels the falling debris. You make it to the entrance as the dome bursts like a bubble. The expedition looks on in a mixture of awe and fear as a torrent of seawater reclaims the alien structure. A small prick of pain shoots through your palm, and you look down to see the node bury itself in your palm, sending spidery black hairs radiating out under your skin. They retract painlessly when you pull the node away. Tillinghast will certainly be pleased with this find.

resolution2.title: Resolution 2
resolution2.body: _Resolution 2_: The reactivated core makes quick work of the flooded dome, draining the water in mere minutes. You survey the perimeter of the sunken ruin with the expedition, marveling at its ancient grandeur. The feeling of walking on a dry ocean floor, with fish flitting beyond the flickering bubble, is like something out of a dream. After several hours, the expedition presses on.

noResolution.title: No Resolution
noResolution.body: _If no resolution was reached_: On the other side of the dome entrance, you look through the gossamer barrier to the ocean floor. The ocean reclaimed the alien dome in mere seconds. It is a minor miracle that you weren’t swept away. Your failure has distracted you from your goals.
